notes.title: 8月10日问题修复Fixed on August 10
notes.content:
1、把护士部件的刷新修改为每次读档都刷新，以防止部分玩家拿取肢体后死亡未存档肢体消失的问题
（当缺少护士肢体时请回原位置寻找，如还未解决问题则有可能是旧存档文件污染，需手动删除
存档位置：C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\BodyCamShoot\Saved\SaveGames\BP_MySaveGame.sav）
2、修复拿取霰弹枪后ui不消失的问题

1. Modify the refresh of the nurse component to refresh each read file to prevent some players from dying after taking the limb and not saving the limb from disappearing
(When missing the nurse's limb, please return to the original location, if the problem is not solved, it may be contaminated by the old archive file, which needs to be manually deleted
Archive location: C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\BodyCamShoot\Saved\SaveGames\BP_MySaveGame.sav)
2. Fixed ui not disappearing after taking shotgun
